title: Sentiment Analysis Platform
subtitle: Large-Scale NLP Processing System
description: Led the development of the core sentiment analysis AI engine for company products, processing web-crawled data to generate sentiment insights integrated with Keypo and DailyView platforms.
longDescription: As the lead engineer for the sentiment analysis AI engine, I developed and maintained the core emotion detection model that processes data from web crawlers. The system analyzes sentiment from crawled content and outputs emotion classification results, which are then integrated with the company's flagship products—Keypo (大數據引擎) and DailyView (網路溫度計)—to provide users with comprehensive online sentiment and buzz analysis. The platform successfully processed over 3 billion data points with a 30% accuracy improvement, enabling real-time sentiment monitoring and trend analysis for business intelligence.
features: Core sentiment analysis AI engine development
Integration with Keypo and DailyView platforms
Online sentiment and buzz analysis for users
solutions: Developed and maintained the core sentiment analysis AI engine
Built data processing pipeline from web crawlers to emotion classification
Integrated sentiment analysis results with Keypo and DailyView products
Implemented distributed processing with Kubernetes for scalability
Optimized models using PaddlePaddle framework for 30% accuracy improvement
Built efficient data pipeline with Elasticsearch for real-time analysis
results: Successfully deployed core sentiment analysis AI engine for company products
Processed over 3 billion data points from web crawlers
Achieved 30% improvement in emotion classification accuracy
Integrated sentiment analysis with Keypo and DailyView platforms
Enabled real-time online sentiment and buzz analysis for end users
Deployed scalable microservices architecture supporting high-volume processing
